oeh_v2.distance: mean distance to the 10 nearest meta-training primary rows in standardized B2 statistics, per MDP-behavior group
oeh_v2.m2: stopped at step 0 (prior_diagnosis/): the continuation rule was not met

rule: external score of the re-selected v2 lower than without M3
SPIBB (rel IBS + rel LL)/2 lower than without M3
internal rel IBS and rel LL vs OEH current each <= +0.02

internal.recipe: two fresh kernels per primary template; distinct from every earlier kernel

colosseum2029.exclusion: every kernel of the 2026, 2027 and 2028 runs

forest.source: pymdptoolbox mdptoolbox.example.forest (Chades et al. 2014; Possingham & Tuck)
forest.selection: first 48 candidates passing the project's dynamic-range filter

budgets.extended_endpoint: first budget of the eight with >=8/10 seeds at it and every larger budget; secondary

data.target: first complete suffix with >=8/10 seeds normalized return >=0.95; else >x50
data.expectile: team's documented IQL expectile fallback, counted, used only where the archived code raises

methods.v2_no_direct_oehb: OEH v2 built on the arm without direct OEH-B (descriptive)
methods.b2_shift: B2 with the v2 shrinkage eps(d) toward the learner prior (descriptive)
methods.legacy_shift: B2 + legacy with the v2 shrinkage eps(d) (descriptive)
methods.factorial: eight P/H/L block arms of OEH current (descriptive Shapley)

gate.unit: MDP; IBS over the six primary thresholds and seven-class log loss (floor 1e-12)
gate.pooled_external: all MDPs of colosseum2029, spibb2 and forest, equal MDP weight
gate.noninferiority: internal: lower bound of (1+0.02) * OEH current - v2 > 0 for IBS and log loss

bootstrap.rule: max-t with the original standard error

step1.what: OEH v2 vs B2 + legacy diagnostics, pooled external MDPs

step2.what: OEH v2 vs OEH current: internal non-inferiority (2% margin) and pooled external superiority

step3.what: OEH v2 vs B2, XGBoost-CF/18, LCE, CB on internal and pooled external

gate.sequence: step 2 only if step 1 is GO, step 3 only if step 2 is GO; closed steps are reported descriptively
gate.success: OEH v2 is adopted if steps 1 and 2 are GO

disclosures: Pipeline dry run before this freeze: 3 development forest MDPs from a different candidate draw (numpy seed 1, not the registered draw 20291014), D:/Tools/colosseum_work/forest_feas; its 45 labels were seen (BC and IQL mostly beyond x50, CFQI mostly at x1). A seed-1 draw of 80 candidates all passed the dynamic-range filter. No registered test MDP, kernel or buffer existed at the freeze.
OEH v2 was frozen (oeh_v2_spec.json) before this protocol; M2 stopped at step 0 and M3 was not adopted by rules_m2_m3.json, so the training panel is the sealed 720-MDP meta panel.
